## 0.2.315

owes: none — SyncCore moves from 0.10.35 to 0.10.39 and DataCore from 0.6.12 to 0.6.16 (intervals owe nothing), Tooling to v0.1.68 (PreToolUse matcher Bash|PowerShell); nothing to do.

owes: none

owes: none — the weather API's `POST /api/v1/weather/places/{id}/refresh` answers `200` with `{"outcome":"ran","ok":…,"error":…}` or `{"outcome":"notDue","nextAt":…}` instead of `204` (a place that is not the caller's stays a 404); a client that expected an empty `204` must read the body. No configuration key, migration or rollback concern.

owes: none — the weather refresh answer is written with the API's own JSON encoder like every other route, so it no longer depends on content negotiation being installed; the body is unchanged.

owes: none — the stocks API gains `POST /api/v1/stocks/refresh`, a person's refresh-now for their own watchlist's quotes (answers `{"outcome":"ran","ok":…,"error":…}` or `{"outcome":"notDue","nextAt":…}`; a failed quote can be retried by hand once a minute). A new route only: no configuration key, migration, wire collection or changed default.
